english: Back to Account
xhosa_before: Buyela kwi-Akhawunti
back_translation: Back to Account

english: Work with your saved sites through an assistant. Choose which sites it may use and disconnect it here whenever you need to.
xhosa_before: Sebenza ngeendawo zakho ezigciniweyo usebenzisa umncedisi. Khetha ukuba zeziphi iindawo anokuzisebenzisa, uze umnqumle apha nanini na xa kufuneka.
back_translation: Work with your saved sites using an assistant. Choose which sites it may use, and cut it off here any time you need.

english: Checking your account…
xhosa_before: Iyajonga i-akhawunti yakho…
back_translation: It is checking your account…

english: Sign in to your ImbewuField account
xhosa_before: Ngena kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-ImbewuField
back_translation: Sign in to your ImbewuField account

english: Your assistant receives its own scoped connection. It does not receive your password.
xhosa_before: Umncedisi wakho ufumana uqhagamshelo lwakhe olunemida. Akayifumani iphasiwedi yakho.
back_translation: Your assistant gets its own connection with limits. It does not get your password.

english: Continue with Google
xhosa_before: Qhubeka nge-Google
back_translation: Continue with Google

english: Password
xhosa_before: Iphasiwedi
back_translation: Password

english: Loading your sites and connections…
xhosa_before: Iyalayisha iindawo zakho noqhagamshelo…
back_translation: Loading your sites and connections…

english: Your account
xhosa_before: I-akhawunti yakho
back_translation: Your account

english: Personal account
xhosa_before: I-akhawunti yobuqu
back_translation: Personal account

english: Connect {name}
xhosa_before: Qhagamshela {name}
back_translation: Connect {name}

english: After you approve, return to
xhosa_before: Emva kokuvuma, buyela ku-
back_translation: After agreeing, go back to

english: Only continue if you started this connection and recognise that destination.
xhosa_before: Qhubeka kuphela ukuba nguwe owaqala olu qhagamshelo kwaye uyayazi leyo ndawo.
back_translation: Continue only if you are the one who started this connection and you know that place.

english: Choose sites to share with this assistant
xhosa_before: Khetha iindawo ozabelana ngazo nalo mncedisi
back_translation: Choose sites to share with this assistant

english: No saved sites are synced to this account yet. You may connect with no sites, then save a site in the app and reconnect to select it.
xhosa_before: Akukabikho ndawo zigciniweyo ezivumelanisiweyo kule akhawunti. Unokuqhagamshela ngaphandle kweendawo, uze ugcine indawo kwi-app, uqhagamshele kwakhona ukuze uyikhethe.
back_translation: No saved sites have been synchronised to this account yet. You can connect without sites, then save a site in the app, connect again so you can choose it.

english: This does not grant access to your Gmail, Drive or computer. New sites need a new connection decision. Connections expire after 90 days; access tokens last one hour.
xhosa_before: Oku akunikezi ufikelelo kwi-Gmail, kwi-Drive okanye kwikhompyuter yakho. Iindawo ezintsha zifuna isigqibo esitsha soqhagamshelo. Uqhagamshelo luphelelwa kwiintsuku ezingama-90; iithokheni zokufikelela zihlala iyure enye.
back_translation: This does not give access to Gmail, Drive or your computer. New sites need a new connection decision. A connection runs out after 90 days; access tokens last one hour.

english: Allow selected access
xhosa_before: Vumela ufikelelo olukhethiweyo
back_translation: Allow the chosen access

english: Cancel connection
xhosa_before: Rhoxisa uqhagamshelo
back_translation: Cancel the connection

english: Connected assistants
xhosa_before: Abancedisi abaqhagamshelweyo
back_translation: Connected assistants

english: {n} selected sites · expires {date}
xhosa_before: Iindawo ezikhethiweyo: {n} · iphelelwa ngomhla we-{date}
back_translation: Chosen sites: {n} · it runs out on the day of {date}
note: Date introduced as "on the day of"; placeholder and expiry kept.

english: Disconnect {name}
xhosa_before: Nqumla {name}
back_translation: Cut off {name}

english: No active assistant connections.
xhosa_before: Akukho qhagamshelo lubalulekileyo lwabancedisi.
back_translation: There is no important connection of assistants.
note: "Active" was drafted as lubalulekileyo, which reads as "important"; now "olusebenzayo" (active/working).

english: Site originals
xhosa_before: Iifayile zoqobo zendawo
back_translation: Original files of the site

english: Imported originals keep their source, byte count and fingerprint. They are separate from the small evidence thumbnails stored on a device.
xhosa_before: Iifayile zoqobo ezingeniswe zigcina umthombo wazo, inani lee-byte nesigxina somnwe. Zahlukile kwiithambnaili ezincinci zobungqina ezigcinwe kwisixhobo.
back_translation: Imported original files keep their source, the number of bytes and a thumbprint. They are different from the small thumbnails of evidence kept on the device.

english: Completed imports remain in ImbewuField after the chat closes.
xhosa_before: Ukungeniswa okugqityiweyo kuhlala kwi-ImbewuField emva kokuba incoko ivaliwe.
back_translation: Finished imports stay in ImbewuField after the chat is closed.

english: {size} bytes · {mime}
xhosa_before: ii-byte ezi-{size} · {mime}
back_translation: {size} bytes · {mime}

english: Import authorisation: {authorisation}
xhosa_before: Imvume yokungenisa: {authorisation}
back_translation: Permission for importing: {authorisation}

english: Open original {name}
xhosa_before: Vula ifayile yoqobo: {name}
back_translation: Open original file: {name}

english: No originals are attached to this site.
xhosa_before: Akukho fayile zoqobo ziqhotyoshelweyo kule ndawo.
back_translation: No original files are attached to this site.

english: Historical photo registration draft
xhosa_before: Idrafti yokuqondanisa ifoto yakudala
back_translation: Draft of aligning an old photo

english: Review registered photograph
xhosa_before: Hlola ifoto eqondaniswe nemephu
back_translation: Check the photo that is aligned with the map

english: {name} · Original bytes verified
xhosa_before: {name} · Ii-byte zoqobo ziqinisekisiwe
back_translation: {name} · Original bytes confirmed

english: Connect an MCP-compatible assistant
xhosa_before: Qhagamshela umncedisi osebenzisana ne-MCP
back_translation: Connect an assistant that works together with MCP

english: Use the ImbewuField private plugin, or add the following Streamable HTTP endpoint in a host that supports OAuth and remote MCP:
xhosa_before: Sebenzisa i-plugin yangasese ye-ImbewuField, okanye ongeze le endpoint ye-Streamable HTTP kwi-host exhasa i-OAuth ne-MCP ekude:
back_translation: Use the private ImbewuField plugin, or you add this Streamable HTTP endpoint to a host that supports OAuth and remote MCP:

english: Your host should open this app’s sign-in and site-selection page. An installed plugin card alone does not mean the connection is authenticated.
xhosa_before: I-host yakho kufuneka ivule iphepha lokungena nelokukhetha indawo lale app. Ikhadi le-plugin efakiweyo yodwa ayithethi ukuba uqhagamshelo luqinisekisiwe.
back_translation: Your host must open this app's page for signing in and choosing the site. The card of an installed plugin alone does not say the connection is confirmed.

english: Photo preview is unavailable on this device.
xhosa_before: Ukujonga ifoto akunakwenzeka kweli sixhobo.
back_translation: Looking at the photo is not possible on this device.

english: The original photo could not be displayed.
xhosa_before: Ifoto yoqobo ayinakubonisa.
back_translation: The original photo cannot show.

english: Registered original photograph with saved design outlines and observed control points
xhosa_before: Ifoto yoqobo eqondaniswe nemephu enemigca yoyilo olugciniweyo namanqaku olawulo abonwe
back_translation: Original photo aligned with the map with saved lines of the design and observed control points

english: Matching error: {rms} pixels RMS; {max} pixels maximum.
xhosa_before: Impazamo yokuqondanisa: ii-pixel ezi-{rms} ze-RMS; ubuninzi bee-pixel ezi-{max}.
back_translation: Alignment error: {rms} pixels of RMS; maximum of {max} pixels.

english: White circles mark matched controls. Green outlines show the saved design. Empty ground stays blank.
xhosa_before: Amacangci amhlophe abonisa amanqaku olawulo aqondanisiweyo. Imigca eluhlaza ibonisa uyilo olugciniweyo. Umhlaba ongenanto uhlala ungenanto.
back_translation: White circles show aligned control points. Green lines show the saved design. Empty land stays empty.

english: Needs visual review · Your current maps and saved geometry are unchanged.
xhosa_before: Kufuneka ihlolwe ngamehlo · Iimephu zakho zangoku nejiyometri egciniweyo azitshintshanga.
back_translation: It must be checked by eye · Your current maps and saved geometry have not changed.

english: Sector maps show clearer wind and rain symbols, with slope and contours kept visible.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeSector zibonisa iimpawu zomoya nezemvula ezicacileyo, umthambeka neemigca yokuphakama kusabonakala.
back_translation: Sector maps show clear wind and rain symbols, slope and contour lines still visible.

english: Sector illustrations have bolder arrows, larger sun symbols and a clearer map key.
xhosa_before: Imizobo yeSector inemitshangatshangana ekhaphukhaphu, iimpawu zelanga ezinkulu nesalathiso semephu esicacileyo.
back_translation: Sector drawings have light/soft arrows, big sun symbols and a clear map key.
xhosa_after: Imizobo yeSector inemitshangatshangana eqaqambileyo, iimpawu zelanga ezinkulu nesalathiso semephu esicacileyo.
note: "Bolder" was drafted as ekhaphukhaphu, which reads as light/soft (the opposite; row 58 correctly uses it for "lighter"). Now eqaqambileyo (prominent).

english: Sector illustrations now show bolder terrain contours and matching key lines.
xhosa_before: Imizobo yeSector ngoku ibonisa iimigca yokuphakama komhlaba ekhaphukhaphu nemigca efanayo kwisalathiso.
back_translation: Sector drawings now show light/soft contour lines of the land and matching lines in the key.
xhosa_after: Imizobo yeSector ngoku ibonisa iimigca yokuphakama komhlaba eqaqambileyo nemigca efanayo kwisalathiso.

english: Sector illustrations keep richer colour, with larger labels and clearer contours.
xhosa_before: Imizobo yeSector igcina imibala ecwebileyo, enamalebula amakhulu neemigca yokuphakama ecacileyo.
back_translation: Sector drawings keep rich colours, with big labels and clear contour lines.

english: Important updates include a short animation you can pause and replay.
xhosa_before: Uhlaziyo olubalulekileyo lubandakanya ibhanyabhanya elifutshane onokulimisa uze ulidlale kwakhona.
back_translation: An important update includes a short film that you can stop and play again.

english: Sector maps use a quieter background and clearer sun, wind and fire marks.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeSector zisebenzisa imvelaphi ethe cwaka nezimpawu ezicacileyo zelanga, zomoya nezomlilo.
back_translation: Sector maps use a quiet background and clear symbols of sun, wind and fire.

english: Choose which saved sites an assistant can use, and disconnect it in Settings.
xhosa_before: Khetha ukuba zeziphi iindawo ezigciniweyo umncedisi anokuzisebenzisa, uze umnqumle kwiisetingi.
back_translation: Choose which saved sites the assistant may use, and cut it off in settings.

english: Keep original site photos and PDFs with their source and import history.
xhosa_before: Gcina iifoto zoqobo zendawo nee-PDF kunye nomthombo wazo nembali yokungeniswa kwazo.
back_translation: Keep original photos of the site and PDFs together with their source and the history of their import.

english: Review historical photo registration drafts without moving saved map features.
xhosa_before: Hlola amadrafti okuqondanisa iifoto zakudala ngaphandle kokushukumisa izinto zemephu ezigciniweyo.
back_translation: Check drafts of aligning old photos without moving the saved map items.

english: Manage assistant access
xhosa_before: Lawula ufikelelo lwabancedisi
back_translation: Manage the access of assistants

english: Settings → Assistant connections
xhosa_before: Iisetingi → Unxibelelwano lomncedisi
back_translation: Settings → Assistant link

english: Review connected assistants, selected sites and imported originals.
xhosa_before: Hlola abancedisi abaqhagamshelweyo, iindawo ezikhethiweyo neefayile zoqobo ezingeniswe.
back_translation: Check connected assistants, chosen sites and imported original files.

english: Check your saved map
xhosa_before: Hlola imephu yakho egciniweyo
back_translation: Check your saved map

english: Site design
xhosa_before: Uyilo lwendawo
back_translation: Site design

english: Review the same site before applying assistant edits or comparing a historical photograph.
xhosa_before: Hlola leyo ndawo ifanayo phambi kokusebenzisa utshintsho lomncedisi okanye ukuthelekisa ifoto yakudala.
back_translation: Check that same site before applying a change from an assistant or comparing an old photo.

english: Open Terrain & Sections for the two cuts and extra contour detail.
xhosa_before: Vula iTerrain & Sections ukuze ubone iziqwenga ezibini nemigca yokuphakama eyongezelelweyo.
back_translation: Open Terrain & Sections to see two pieces and extra contour lines.

english: Sector illustrations have lighter arrows, clearer contours and a shorter map key.
xhosa_before: Imizobo yeSector inemitshangatshangana ethambileyo, iimigca yokuphakama ecacileyo nesalathiso semephu esifutshane.
back_translation: Sector drawings have soft arrows, clear contour lines and a short map key.

english: Terrain profiles show sampled elevation and classroom positions at the plan scale.
xhosa_before: Iiprofayile zomhlaba zibonisa ukuphakama okuthathiweyo kwisampulu neendawo zeeklasi kwisikali secwangciso.
back_translation: Land profiles show the height taken at the sample and the zones of classes at the scale of the plan.
note: Source says "classroom positions" (looks like a source typo for class); draft reads "zones of classes". Flag for the source owner, not changed.

english: Review the shade cover
xhosa_before: Hlola isigqubuthelo sesithunzi
back_translation: Check the shade overlay

english: Open Structures, then reassemble the saved AI artwork to show its shade cover.
xhosa_before: Vula iStructures, uze udibanise kwakhona umzobo we-AI ogciniweyo ukuze ubonise isigqubuthelo sawo sesithunzi.
back_translation: Open Structures, then join again the saved AI drawing so that it shows its shade overlay.

english: Structures maps show recorded shade cloth over the illustrated beds.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeStructures zibonisa ilaphu lesithunzi elirekhodiweyo phezu kwemibhede ezotyiweyo.
back_translation: Structures maps show the recorded shade cloth over the drawn beds.

english: Sector maps use regional overview contours, with an optional A–B terrain profile.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeSector zisebenzisa iimigca yokuphakama yommandla jikelele, nenketho yeprofayile yomhlaba ye-A–B.
back_translation: Sector maps use contour lines of the whole area, with an option of a land profile A–B.

english: Exact and illustrated Water maps now show the same water budget.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeWater ezichanekileyo nezizotyiweyo ngoku zibonisa uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lwamanzi olufanayo.
back_translation: Accurate and drawn Water maps now show the same water budget.

english: Zone maps trim blurry aerial edges when the photo covers the site.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeZone zisusa imiphetho engacacanga yefoto yasemoyeni xa ifoto igubungela indawo yonke.
back_translation: Zone maps remove the blurred edges of the aerial photo when the photo covers the whole site.

english: Existing Site labels and legend now use matching symbols.
xhosa_before: Amalebula esalathiso seExisting Site ngoku asebenzisa iimpawu ezifanayo.
back_translation: Key labels of Existing Site now use the same symbols.

english: Choose area names or a numbered key on the historical Existing Site map.
xhosa_before: Khetha amagama emimandla okanye isalathiso esinamanani kwimephu yembali yeExisting Site.
back_translation: Choose names of zones or a numbered key on the map of the history of Existing Site.

english: Ubhejane Site and Sector maps can show the before-works archive photograph.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zeSite neSector ze-Ubhejane zinokubonisa ifoto yengobo yangaphambi kwemisebenzi.
back_translation: Ubhejane Site and Sector maps can show a photo of the ingobo before the works.
xhosa_after: Iimephu zeSite neSector ze-Ubhejane zinokubonisa ifoto egciniweyo yangaphambi kwemisebenzi.
note: "archive photograph" was drafted as ifoto yengobo, a word that does not read as archive; now "saved/archived photo".

english: AI maps start with available aerial imagery; you can still choose plain paper.
xhosa_before: Iimephu ze-AI ziqala ngemifanekiso yasemoyeni ekhoyo; usenakho ukukhetha iphepha elimhlophe.
back_translation: AI maps start with existing aerial images; you can still choose a white page.

english: AI Site and Sector maps keep their painted detail, with fewer photo strips.
xhosa_before: Iimephu ze-AI zeSite neSector zigcina iinkcukacha zazo ezipeyintiweyo, zinemitya yeefoto embalwa.
back_translation: AI Site and Sector maps keep their painted details, with few photo stripes.

english: Phasing keeps painted artwork; the app adds its schedule, pins and scale.
xhosa_before: IPhasing igcina umzobo opeyintiweyo; i-app yongeza ishedyuli, iipini nesikali.
back_translation: Phasing keeps the painted drawing; the app adds schedule, pins and scale.

english: Paper-friendly map styles start on white and keep your chosen background.
xhosa_before: Izimbo zemephu ezilungele iphepha ziqala kumhlophe zigcine imvelaphi oyikhethileyo.
back_translation: Page-friendly map styles start at white and keep the background you choose.

english: Review the AI map finish
xhosa_before: Hlola ukugqitywa kwemephu ye-AI
back_translation: Check completion of the AI map

english: Site design → Glossy
xhosa_before: Uyilo lwendawo → Glossy
back_translation: Site design → Glossy

english: Choose a sheet and style. Paper-friendly styles start on white unless you choose another background.
xhosa_before: Khetha ishiti nesimbo. Izimbo ezilungele iphepha ziqala kumhlophe ngaphandle kokuba ukhetha enye imvelaphi.
back_translation: Choose a sheet and a style. Page-friendly styles start at white unless you choose another background.

english: Compare with your exact plan
xhosa_before: Thelekisa necwangciso lakho elichanekileyo
back_translation: Compare with your accurate plan

english: Site design → Saved maps
xhosa_before: Uyilo lwendawo → Iimephu ezigciniweyo
back_translation: Site design → Saved maps

english: Open the saved exact plan beside its AI illustration. Check bed corners, buildings and plants before using the illustration.
xhosa_before: Vula icwangciso elichanekileyo eligciniweyo ecaleni komzobo walo we-AI. Hlola iikona zemibhede, izakhiwo nezityalo phambi kokusebenzisa lo mzobo.
back_translation: Open the saved accurate plan next to its AI drawing. Check the corners of beds, buildings and plants before using this drawing.

english: Explore international reference drafts; local farming advice remains unavailable.
xhosa_before: Phonononga amadrafti ezalathiso zamanye amazwe; iingcebiso zokulima zasekuhlaleni zisengekafumaneki.
back_translation: Browse drafts of references from other countries; local farming advice is not yet available.
note: "remains unavailable" read as "not yet available" (implies coming); local advice still not offered.

english: Review international references
xhosa_before: Hlola izalathiso zamanye amazwe
back_translation: Check references from other countries

english: International foundation
xhosa_before: Isiseko samanye amazwe
back_translation: Base of other countries

english: Compare country evidence, language drafts and fictional project examples.
xhosa_before: Thelekisa ubungqina bamazwe, amadrafti ezilwimi neemizekelo yeeprojekthi eyentsomi.
back_translation: Compare evidence of countries, language drafts and fictional project examples.

english: Plan seedlings, trays and nursery space with your own equipment and estimates.
xhosa_before: Cwangcisa izithole, iitreyi nendawo yenkulisa usebenzisa izixhobo neengqikelelo zakho.
back_translation: Plan seedlings, trays and nursery area using your tools and ideas.

english: Check nursery space
xhosa_before: Hlola indawo yenkulisa
back_translation: Check the nursery area

english: Crop planner → Nursery planner
xhosa_before: Isicwangcisi sezityalo → Isicwangcisi senkulisa
back_translation: Crop plan → Nursery plan

english: Add your tray sizes, usable nursery surface and crop estimates. Review overlapping demand and missing information before adding automatic sowings.
xhosa_before: Yongeza ubungakanani beetreyi zakho, umphezulu wenkulisa osebenzisekayo neengqikelelo zezityalo. Hlola imfuno edibeneyo nolwazi olusilelayo phambi kokongeza ukutyala okuzenzekelayo.
back_translation: Add the sizes of your trays, the usable nursery surface and ideas of plants. Check the combined demand and missing information before adding automatic planting.

english: Choose Editorial Atlas for a lighter AI style and a circular Sector diagram.
xhosa_before: Khetha i-Editorial Atlas ukuze ufumane isitayile se-AI esikhaphukhaphu nomzobo ojikelezayo we-Sector.
back_translation: Choose Editorial Atlas for a light AI style and a rotating Sector drawing.
note: "circular" Sector diagram read as "rotating"; left, low risk.

english: Maps have finer boundaries with round posts and clearer Earthworks labels.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zinemida ecekethekileyo eneepali ezingqukuva neelebheli ze-Earthworks ezicace ngakumbi.
back_translation: Maps have dashed borders with round pins and clearer Earthworks labels.
xhosa_after: Iimephu zinemida emincinci eneepali ezingqukuva neelebheli ze-Earthworks ezicace ngakumbi.
note: "finer boundaries" was drafted as ecekethekileyo, read blind as dashed/notched; now emincinci (thin/fine).

english: Terrain maps show elevation, slope percentage and degrees from local terrain data.
xhosa_before: Iimephu zomhlaba zibonisa ukuphakama, ipesenti yethambeka needigri ezivela kwidatha yomhlaba yendawo.
back_translation: Land maps show height, percent of slope and degrees from the data of the local land.
